-- Add stable source key for importing queue/details from local generated files.

alter table review.match_candidate_queue
  add column if not exists source_candidate_key text

create unique index if not exists ux_match_candidate_queue_batch_source_key
  on review.match_candidate_queue (
    coalesce(source_batch_id, ''),
    source_channel,
    coalesce(source_candidate_key, '')
  )
  where source_candidate_key is not null
    and source_candidate_key <> ''

create index if not exists ix_match_candidate_queue_source_key
  on review.match_candidate_queue(source_channel, source_candidate_key)
